lines.explanation: Read-only profile check for two named, resolved users.
Read-only channel review of #engineering, resolved channel.
Read-only search for channels discussing 'this topic'; underspecified referent card does not deactivate a read-only check per rule 3.
Conditional branch check ('if no dedicated space yet') is itself a read-only determination, active per rule 3.

Creating a new channel is a state-changing action but has no directly linked grounding card with absent/underspecified resolution (card for O4 attaches to line 3/4, not to the create-channel action itself); no essential input is missing (name/topic derivable from context), so active.
Posting a heads-up in #core-infra is state-changing but its linked card (core-infra resolution) is resolved, and content is derivable from context, so active.
State-changing reaction action is linked to an underspecified grounding card (Aisha's specific message is not distinguished among six candidates), triggering rule 4 inactivation.
State-changing removal action is linked to two underspecified grounding cards (unnamed person and unnamed project channel), triggering rule 4 inactivation.
